New Tunnel Floods Weeks After Opening, NHAI Admits Flaws

India's first eight-lane Mukundara tunnel in Kota began flooding with rainwater just weeks after its inauguration. The National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) has acknowledged flaws in the Rs 12.50-crore project. The tunnel experienced waterlogging during recent rains.
